scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify-syntax --minify-whitespace --keep-names --bytecode --sourcemap --target=bun src/cli.ts --outfile dist/kei && cp -R std dist/std
scripts.format: oxfmt src tests package.json tsconfig.json knip.jsonc .oxlintrc.jsonc .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src tests package.json tsconfig.json knip.jsonc .oxlintrc.jsonc .oxfmtrc.json
